# Release 1.4.0 summary

## Breaking changes

- Version 1 of the API is gone (#12).
  What you need to do: move your calls to the version 2 endpoints before you upgrade.

## What's new

- You can now export your data (#15).
- The login page now shows the correct error message (#16).

## What to watch

- Export stops at 10000 rows (#15).
